name: The Emperor of Palamecia // The Lord Master of Hell
clause: {T}: Add {U} or {R}. Spend this mana only to cast a noncreature spell. | Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, if at least four mana was spent to cast it, put a +1/+1 counter on ~. Then if it has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, transform it.

needs.proposedSignature: { kind: 'self-has-counters'; counter: string; atLeast?: number }  (extend the existing condition; equivalently a new { kind: 'counters-on-source-ge'; counter: string; value: number })
needs.semantics: True when the source has at least `atLeast` counters of that kind on it, evaluated as the effect applies. Today `self-has-counters` is a name-only >= 1 test and no Condition accepts an Amount, so the very common 'Then if there are N or more <x> counters on it, ...' transform trigger cannot be written at all - any encoding flips the permanent on the first counter. Pairs with the existing removeCounters cost / a negative `counters` amount for the 'remove those counters' half.
needs.clause: Then if there are three or more landmark counters on it, remove those counters, transform ~, and create three Treasure tokens.

needs.proposedSignature: add-mana `restriction` gains 'noncreature-spell' (ideally becomes a Filter); condition { kind: 'mana-spent-ge'; value: number } reading the triggering spell's total mana paid
needs.semantics: 'Spend this mana only to cast a noncreature spell.' - the restriction enum today is only creature-spell / instant-sorcery / chosen-type-creature / colorless-eldrazi. 'if at least four mana was spent to cast it' needs the amount of mana actually paid for the triggering spell (X and cost increases included), which nothing records.
